# progress

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/progress"
```

Package progress draws how far along something is: a bar for a count of items, and a stepper for a sequence of named stages such as a wizard's. Everything is one row, exactly the width asked for, in the theme's colours.

<a name="Bar"></a>
## func [Bar](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/progress/progress.go#L19>)

```go
func Bar(done, total, width int, th theme.Resolved) string
```

Bar is a done/total bar width cells wide: filled in the accent colour, the rest muted. A zero total reads as nothing done.

<a name="Gauge"></a>
## func [Gauge](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/progress/gauge.go#L13>)

```go
func Gauge(value, total float64, width int, th theme.Resolved) string
```

Gauge is value out of total as a needle under a ruled track width cells wide, two rows: the track with a tick every quarter, then the needle. The value is a float, so a Spring can carry the needle smoothly.

<a name="Line"></a>
## func [Line](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/progress/progress.go#L34>)

```go
func Line(label string, done, total, width int, th theme.Resolved) string
```

Line is label, a bar and "done/total" in one row width cells wide. The bar takes what the label and the count leave; when space runs out the bar goes first, then the label is cut, and the count stays.

<a name="Meter"></a>
## func [Meter](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/progress/progress.go#L76>)

```go
func Meter(done, total, width int, th theme.Resolved) string
```

Meter is done/total as width squares: the filled ones coloured along the theme's ramp from the left, the rest hollow, so it reads without colour.

<a name="Smooth"></a>
## func [Smooth](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/progress/progress.go#L108>)

```go
func Smooth(done, total, width int, th theme.Resolved, opts ...Option) string
```

Smooth is done/total as a bar width cells wide whose edge is cut to an eighth of a cell, over a muted track as Bar's.

<a name="Stepper"></a>
## func [Stepper](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/progress/progress.go#L47>)

```go
func Stepper(steps []string, current, width int, th theme.Resolved, set icon.Set) string
```

Stepper is a row of named stages: those before current marked done, current marked running, the rest pending. current == len\(steps\) marks every stage done. When the row does not fit width it becomes "Step 2 of 4 · Name".

<a name="Option"></a>
## type [Option](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/progress/progress.go#L96>)

Option changes how Smooth draws its bar.

```go
type Option func(*look)
```

<a name="InSeries"></a>
### func [InSeries](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/progress/progress.go#L101>)

```go
func InSeries(i int) Option
```

InSeries fills the bar in the theme's i\-th series colour instead of the accent.
